title: Write-behind: the cache acknowledges now and the database catches up later
caption: Writes are as fast as the cache, and can be batched, but anything not yet flushed is lost if the cache dies.

messages.label: INCR views:9 (×1000)
messages.note: A thousand writes land in memory at ~0.5 ms each.

messages.label: ok
messages.note: The caller is acknowledged before the database knows anything.

messages.label: flush: views += 1000
messages.note: Every second, a background flush writes one batched update instead of a thousand.

messages.label: crash before flush
messages.note: If the cache node fails between flushes, those increments are gone. Use it only for data you can lose or rebuild.
